```{r score RPAS}
# Code script to score the Revised Physical Anhedonia Scale - Chapman et al. (1976)
# https://doi.org/10.1037/0021-843X.85.4.374
# Scoring instructions: Items that need to be are reverse scored so that the more anhedonic response corresponds to 1 for each individual item. Then, both the sum of the individual item responses and the average of these responses are calculated for summary measures. A higher score indicates greater anhedonia.

# Load required packages (optional, for tidy syntax)
library(dplyr)
library (readr)

# Load data
RPAS <- read_tsv("/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/separate_tsvs/rpas.tsv")

# Compute total scores for each individual participant
rev_items <- c(
  "phys_anhed_1","phys_anhed_2","phys_anhed_3","phys_anhed_4",
  "phys_anhed_7","phys_anhed_9","phys_anhed_11","phys_anhed_12",
  "phys_anhed_13","phys_anhed_14","phys_anhed_15"
)
keep_items <- c("phys_anhed_5","phys_anhed_6","phys_anhed_8","phys_anhed_10", rev_items)
RPAS <- RPAS %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(keep_items), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(rev_items), ~ 1 - .x)) %>%
  mutate(
    rpas_total_score = rowSums(across(all_of(keep_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
    rpas_average_score = rowMeans(across(all_of(keep_items)), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
write_tsv(RPAS,"/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/final_scored_tsvs/rpas.tsv", na = "n/a")
```
``` {r RPAS distribution}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

RPAS %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rpas_total_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "RPAS total score (sum of 15 items)", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of RPAS total scores")

RPAS %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rpas_average_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "RPAS average score", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of RPAS average scores")

```
